question: The sum of the area of two squares whose sides are p cm and q cm, respectively, is 317 cm² and the sum of their perimeters is 100 cm. Find the product of p and q.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of perimeters ⇒ 4(p + q) = 100 ⇒ **p + q = 25**

Sum of areas ⇒ p² + q² = 317

Using identity: (p + q)² = p² + q² + 2pq

25² = 317 + 2pq ⇒ 625 − 317 = 2pq ⇒ 308 = 2pq

pq = 154

**∴ The correct answer is 154 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01a96ceded0d0441a66704bafb2ffcd81ec6d6d168b199d3da254bd283f1bcc4.png] 

**Given:**

Area of square 1 + Area of square 2 = 317 cm²

Perimeter of square 1 + Perimeter of square 2 = 100 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of square = **side²**

Perimeter of square = **4 × side**

Algebraic identity: **(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab**

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4p + 4q = 100

⇒ 4(p + q) = 100

⇒ p + q = 25

⇒ p² + q² = 317

⇒ (p + q)² = p² + q² + 2pq

⇒ (25)² = 317 + 2pq

⇒ 625 = 317 + 2pq

⇒ 2pq = 625 − 317

⇒ 2pq = 308

⇒ pq = 154

**∴ The correct answer is 154 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Square

A square has four equal sides and four right angles. The diagonal of a square is √2 × side.

Algebraic Identities

Useful in geometry: (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab and a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b).

Diagonal and Area Relationship

The area of a square can also be calculated as (Diagonal)² ÷ 2.</p
